{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude non-converted completed orders (likely internal test orders)
final_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Check the revenue column's dtype
print("Revenue column dtype:", final_orders['revenue'].dtype)

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
final_orders['revenue'] = final_orders['revenue'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
final_orders['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(final_orders['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = final_orders['revenue'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
